outcome: An upload larger than the configured limit is refused before it is stored.

acceptance_criteria.text: An upload within the limit is accepted.

expected_verification.assertion: a 1 KB upload does not throw

acceptance_criteria.text: An upload larger than the limit is refused, whatever size the caller claims it is.

expected_verification.assertion: an upload whose actual size exceeds the limit throws upload_too_large

security_impact: An unbounded upload is a storage and cost exhaustion vector.
